objective: By 2026-03-31, identify one repeatable Twitter/X acquisition path that delivers >= 40 qualified trials at <= $120 CAC and >= 12% trial-to-activation rate.

target_audience.primary_icp: Technical founders and engineering leads running multi-agent workflows who need execution visibility, approvals, and continuity in one control surface.
pain_points: Agent execution status is fragmented across chats and terminals.
Decisions and blockers are easy to miss, causing stalled workstreams.
Manual orchestration and handoffs create avoidable overhead as runs scale.
Teams need auditability and reliable progress data even during connectivity issues.

proof_points: Mission Control view maps initiatives, workstreams, milestones, and tasks.
Live activity timeline provides continuous run-level signal.
Decision queue centralizes approval prompts and status.
Next-up queue helps teams keep work moving without manual triage.
Outbox buffering and replay preserve event continuity during API downtime.
Dashboard surfaces pending/replayed events to maintain operator trust.

timeline.milestone: Discovery setup complete (tracking, audiences, creative hypotheses)
Round 1 test launch (3 audiences x 2 creatives)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Problem-first copy focused on blocked execution will outperform feature-first copy on CTR by >= 20%.
Follower-lookalike targeting around agent tooling accounts will deliver lower CAC than broad keyword targeting.

audiences: Interest stack: AI tooling, dev productivity, MLOps
Follower lookalikes: OpenClaw/Codex/agent tooling adjacent accounts
creative_matrix: Variant A: mission-control screenshot + pain-led hook
Variant B: GIF demo + operator-led CTA
Variant C: social-proof quote + setup simplicity CTA
tracking_requirements: UTM naming by audience and creative variant
Post-click events: visit, onboarding start, workspace connected
Weekly cohort readout for CAC and activation quality

assumptions: Primary destination remains the OrgX OpenClaw integration landing surface.
Conversion tracking can attribute onboarding starts and successful connects.
